title: Distributing over a group with a letter in it

ask.text: Write the load.

hints.text: One lock, several wards. Whatever the outside takes, every ward takes.
The collar outside multiplies the collar inside. The socket rides along untouched.
The socket term has climbed to a count of 16. The fixed weight is still waiting.

worldFraming.text: The ward has a socket in it now. The value scales what it is rated for, never what it is made of.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: One lock, several wards. Whatever the outside takes, every ward takes.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: You can watch the rating climb on the plate as it goes in.

ask.text: Stack a load that gathers to 8*x + 16.

hints.text: One lock, several wards. Whatever the outside takes, every ward takes.
Build it long. It only has to gather short.
Gathered, it must read 8*x + 16. How it gets there is yours.

worldFraming.text: You can watch the rating climb on the plate as it goes in.
